claims.title: Reusable attachment: exact rigid clearance, issued energy boundary and finite cost budgets

quoted_fields.interface: Symmetric orthogonal rigid-clearance geometry at declared common anchors; initial engagement and loaded reversal use P-P. Separate introduced service/finance inputs at100 services/year/10y8%, and a diffusion film with specified D, concentration, footprint and current use. Guide rocking, elasticity, fields, chemical preparation, finished-part function and actual accepted denominator are not supplied.
quoted_fields.failure: Exact geometry is for the stated linearized rigid model, not full finite-rotation/elastic joint or independent moving-stem modes. Finance is a fixed comparator/floor screen, not a universal impossibility or quote. Film diffusion/current-use law is introduced, not measured printing rate or a complete feed/renewal/functioning part. Source access failure is not negative science.
